entities.name: Thada Adel
entities.description: Zendikar merfolk rogue and leader of the Tikal Harborage, a former adventurer.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: Merfolk leader of Coralhelm Refuge and Thada Adel's greatest enemy.

entities.name: Tikal Harborage
entities.description: Half-submerged merfolk outpost upriver from Sea Gate, where mages use hedrons against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Coralhelm Refuge
entities.description: Merfolk refuge led by Noyan Dar.

events.summary: Noyan Dar tries to recruit Thada Adel at the Enclave; she takes an instant dislike to him.
events.quote: Noyan Dar attempted to recruit her into his circle of cronies

relations.note: Her greatest enemy, with bitter mutual grudges.
relations.quote: Thada Adel's greatest enemy is someone who shares her goals as well as her skills
Thada Adel now leads the largest of the merfolk outposts known as the Tikal Harborage
